stops.note: pro- 'before' plus tegere 'to cover' - literally to cover in front of
the past participle of protéger was used as a noun for someone sheltered by a patron
borrowed, still printed in italics as a foreign word, for a person guided by an influential mentor
stops.meaning: a person guided and supported by an older or more experienced person

current_meaning: a person under the patronage or guidance of someone influential
